prompt: A short stubby toy missile lying level and horizontal, pointing to the left, seen from the side: a big black binder clip sits ON TOP of the missile, its jaws gripping the top of the missile body and its two silver handles pointing straight up (to clip onto a wing above). The clip is large, about a third of the missile's length. The missile is mostly a big pink cone-shaped pencil cap eraser: pointy nose at the left, wide hollow open back end at the right as the exhaust nozzle, four small cross-shaped blue paper fins at the back. Shown alone, single object centred, plain cream background, soft studio light, no text, no logos, no grip, no tape, no stand. Glossy opaque molded plastic like a piece snapped off a toy soldier set. Small, compact and simple with few parts.
